description: Returns the characters saved on this aicut account, newest first, one page at a time: `kind: "uploaded"` entries the user made from their own photos and `kind: "cast_member"` entries generated as AI Video Story cast. Each carries an id, a display name, a portrait `image_url` where one exists and, for cast members, the visual `world`. Read-only: it creates nothing and spends nothing. WHEN: the user wants to reuse a character ('same cast as last time') or you want to show what the account has. `world` DOES NOT IDENTIFY THE SERIES and nothing on these rows does (a world is shared by many series), so 'the same cast as last time' cannot be answered from this list alone, and that is a MONEY point: never pick members for a story create by matching `world` to the series. Name the candidates to the user and let them confirm, or draft a fresh cast with `generate_cast` (free): a wrong pick is only discovered after the frames are drawn and charged. WHAT EACH KIND CAN DO: `cast_member` ids are what `generate_story_video` takes as `cast_member_ids`; a cast member's portrait `image_url` is usually one of this account's own images and can go into `generate_*` media fields (members on a series' stock preset carry a shared url those fields refuse). `uploaded` ids are what `generate_video` takes as `character_ids` (a flat 0.2 tokens on top of the video); their portrait urls are NOT accepted by media fields (a saved character is not an `upload_media` upload): pass the id. Paging: `cursor` from the previous `next_cursor` while `has_more` is true.

cursor.description: The previous response's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

name: list_characters
title: List aicut characters
